about: Where every fixture in this directory comes from. Doc links are pinned to commit 995f6eb3 of binance/binance-spot-api-docs, the source of developers.binance.com/docs/binance-spot-api-docs. No fixture came from a signed or account endpoint.

exchange_info_btcusdt.json.how: The public, unauthenticated response fetched at 2026-11-10T23:35:13Z, unmodified (sha256 8d459563efe940b63c89b9dda5791db955e2b93ff3844de937ece99dd9f4ed83). Format: https://github.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/blob/995f6eb39dda0ccba328247ed7087fa7e5b9c5dd/rest-api.md#L884-L1010 and https://github.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/blob/995f6eb39dda0ccba328247ed7087fa7e5b9c5dd/filters.md

account.json.how: The documented response of GET /api/v3/account, comments removed

order.json.how: The documented response of GET /api/v3/order, comments removed

open_orders.json.how: The documented response of GET /api/v3/openOrders, comments removed

my_trades.json.how: The documented response of GET /api/v3/myTrades. Paging tests derive further trades from this record, changing only id, orderId and time

commission.json.how: The documented response of GET /api/v3/account/commission, comments removed

errors.json.how: Error bodies in Binance's documented shape (https://github.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/blob/995f6eb39dda0ccba328247ed7087fa7e5b9c5dd/rest-api.md#L145-L155): -2013 errors.md#L435 (body as in CHANGELOG.md#L2164-L2167), -2026 errors.md#L451 (body as in CHANGELOG.md#L2173-L2176), -1007 errors.md#L39, -1000 errors.md#L15, -1121 errors.md#L177, -1003 errors.md#L27 with the template filled from the live REQUEST_WEIGHT limit. html_page is constructed: Binance documents no body for a non-JSON answer. Binance does not pair codes with HTTP statuses beyond rest-api.md#L132-L143, so each test chooses the status and says so

reads.json.how: Golden table of every read: method, path and parameters (timestamp and signature removed, sorted), whether it is signed, and its documented weight at the cited lines

agg_trade.json.how: The documented payload of the <symbol>@aggTrade stream (stream name at https://github.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/blob/995f6eb39dda0ccba328247ed7087fa7e5b9c5dd/web-socket-streams.md#L274), comments removed. It carries "M" ("Ignore"), for which the shared wire type AggTradeEvent has no field

server_shutdown.json.how: The documented serverShutdown event on a raw stream, comments removed

facts.about: Venue facts the spot trade feed (ADR-0056 step 8b) relies on, read 2026-11-11 at the same commit
facts.raw_stream_path: https://github.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/blob/995f6eb39dda0ccba328247ed7087fa7e5b9c5dd/web-socket-streams.md#L42-L47: a raw stream at /ws/<streamName>; a combined stream at /stream?streams=... wraps each event as {stream, data}
facts.connection_lifetime: https://github.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/blob/995f6eb39dda0ccba328247ed7087fa7e5b9c5dd/web-socket-streams.md#L49-L50: one connection is valid for 24 hours
facts.server_shutdown: https://github.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/blob/995f6eb39dda0ccba328247ed7087fa7e5b9c5dd/web-socket-streams.md#L51-L53, #L85-L110: a serverShutdown event precedes a disconnection
facts.ping_pong: https://github.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/blob/995f6eb39dda0ccba328247ed7087fa7e5b9c5dd/web-socket-streams.md#L54-L59: a ping every 20 seconds; no pong within a minute disconnects; the pong copies the ping's payload
